instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. In an outdoor European street, the blonde woman in the gray turtleneck (R1) stands on the left, leaning close to her partner and looking up to the right with a joyful smile. Beside her, the man in the tan corduroy jacket (R2) stands on the right, holding his arm up to take a selfie while looking up and smiling. The couple is positioned closely together against a softly blurred background of white buildings. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural daylight, creating a warm and bright atmosphere.
